--- /dev/null
+++ b/h11/tests/test_obsolete_folding_policy.py
@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+import h11
+import pytest
+
+
+def _client(allow):
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.CLIENT, allow_obsolete_folding=allow)
+    c.send(h11.Request(method="GET", target="/", headers=[("Host", "a")]))
+    c.send(h11.EndOfMessage())
+    return c
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [100, 200])
+def test_strict_response_headers(status):
+    c = _client(False)
+    wire = (
+        b"HTTP/1.1 " + str(status).encode("ascii") + b" "
+        b"OK\r\nX-Test: first\r\n second\r\n\r\n"
+    )
+    c.receive_data(wire)
+    with pytest.raises(h11.RemoteProtocolError):
+        c.next_event()
+    assert c.their_state is h11.ERROR
+    assert c.our_state is not h11.ERROR
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fragmented", [False, True])
+def test_strict_request_headers(fragmented):
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER, allow_obsolete_folding=False)
+    wire = b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\nX-Test: first\r\n\tsecond\r\n\r\n"
+    if fragmented:
+        for byte in wire[:-1]:
+            c.receive_data(bytes([byte]))
+            assert c.next_event() is h11.NEED_DATA
+        c.receive_data(wire[-1:])
+    else:
+        c.receive_data(wire)
+    with pytest.raises(h11.RemoteProtocolError):
+        c.next_event()
+    assert c.their_state is h11.ERROR
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("allow", [None, True])
+def test_compatible_unfolding(allow):
+    kwargs = {} if allow is None else {"allow_obsolete_folding": allow}
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER, **kwargs)
+    c.receive_data(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\nX-Test: first\r\n second\r\n\r\n")
+    request = c.next_event()
+    assert isinstance(request, h11.Request)
+    assert list(request.headers) == [(b"host", b"a"), (b"x-test", b"first second")]
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), h11.EndOfMessage)
+
+
+def test_strict_chunked_trailers():
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER, allow_obsolete_folding=False)
+    c.receive_data(b"POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n")
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), h11.Request)
+    c.receive_data(b"1\r\nx\r\n0\r\nX-Test: first\r\n second\r\n\r\n")
+    assert c.next_event().data == b"x"
+    with pytest.raises(h11.RemoteProtocolError):
+        c.next_event()
+    assert c.their_state is h11.ERROR
+
+
+def test_policy_survives_cycle_reset():
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER, allow_obsolete_folding=False)
+    c.receive_data(b"GET /one HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\n\r\n")
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), h11.Request)
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), h11.EndOfMessage)
+    c.send(h11.Response(status_code=204, headers=[]))
+    c.send(h11.EndOfMessage())
+    c.start_next_cycle()
+    c.receive_data(b"GET /two HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: a\r\nX-Test: first\r\n second\r\n\r\n")
+    with pytest.raises(h11.RemoteProtocolError):
+        c.next_event()
+
+
+def test_nonfolded_lf_headers_still_work():
+    c = h11.Connection(h11.SERVER, allow_obsolete_folding=False)
+    c.receive_data(b"GET / HTTP/1.1\nHost: a\nX-Test: first\n\n")
+    request = c.next_event()
+    assert isinstance(request, h11.Request)
+    assert list(request.headers) == [(b"host", b"a"), (b"x-test", b"first")]
+    assert isinstance(c.next_event(), h11.EndOfMessage)
+    assert c.next_event() is h11.NEED_DATA

spec.question: Add an optional Connection constructor keyword, `allow_obsolete_folding`, defaulting to `True`. When it is `False`, receiving an obsolete folded header—a continuation line beginning with space or tab—must raise RemoteProtocolError and put the peer role in ERROR. Apply this policy to request headers, informational and final response headers, and chunked trailers. The policy must survive start_next_cycle(). With the default or an explicit True, preserve the current unfolding behavior. This option must not change outgoing serialization, event-constructor validation, or the existing acceptance of LF-only header line endings.
